description: This file defines an in-memory mock implementation of the NotesApi interface, allowing storing and fetching notes with concurrency support and last-write-wins logic based on updatedAt timestamps.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesApi
classes.description: In-memory mock backend implementing the NotesApi interface, managing notes storage with concurrency and last-write-wins update policy.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Stores a list of notes, updating existing entries only if the incoming note has a newer or equal timestamp.

methods.name: fetchNotesUpdatedSince
methods.description: Retrieves notes updated after a specified epoch timestamp, sorted by most recent update.
